title: re-enactment of Game of Thrones
text:
trying to re-enact the scenes from Game of Thrones where they were shot .
Also the scale and antiquity of the beautiful buildings.
author: Ashwin_C

title: Catalan medieval history tour
text: Driver no guide.  Great way to visit these locations with maximum flexibility.  Some commentary on drive, but need to read up about these towns ahead of time.  Seeing Game of Thrones stairs was fun.
author: Barry_W
